signature.name: VTask.memPartition
signature.type: {α : Type u_1} -> (f : ℕ → Set α) -> ℕ → Set (Set α)

conventions.statement: VTask.memPartition f 0 = {Set.univ} for all f, making the partition trivially the whole universe at depth 0.
Pieces of the partition may be empty sets; no non-emptiness restriction is imposed on members of the collection.
conventions.note: Occurs when f n = univ or f n = ∅ causes a difference or intersection to be empty.

facts.statement: ∀ (α : Type*) (f : ℕ → Set α) (n : ℕ), MeasurableSpace.generateFrom (VTask.memPartition f n) ≤ MeasurableSpace.generateFrom (VTask.memPartition f (n + 1))

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6, validated against ground truth

facts.statement: ∀ (α : Type*) (f : ℕ → Set α), MeasurableSpace.generateFrom (⋃ n, VTask.memPartition f n) = MeasurableSpace.generateFrom (Set.range f)

provenance.note: authored by eu.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6, validated against ground truth
